# The canvas block: a drawing opened from its .excalidraw file, drawn on,
# written back by itself; a change on disk taken in; a new canvas.
size:1280x800
wait:0.5
open:@DIR@/sketch.excalidraw
wait:1.5
page-wait:go
expect-tab:sketch.excalidraw
page-js:new Promise(r => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (window.libertty_canvas) { clearInterval(t); r("ready"); } }, 50); setTimeout(() => r("never"), 4000); }) ==> ready
page-js:libertty_canvas.api.getSceneElements().length ==> 1
# Draw a rectangle: the file has it a moment later, without ⌘S.
page-js:(() => { const a = libertty_canvas.api; const el = { ...a.getSceneElements()[0], id: "probe-rect", x: 300, y: 200, version: 1, versionNonce: 7, seed: 7 }; a.updateScene({ elements: [...a.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted(), el] }); return a.getSceneElements().length; })() ==> 2
wait:1.5
expect-shell:grep -c '"type": "rectangle"' @DIR@/sketch.excalidraw ==> 2
expect-shell:grep -c probe-rect @DIR@/sketch.excalidraw ==> 1
shot:canvas.png
# Changed elsewhere (nothing unsaved here): the drawing follows the file.
shell:python3 -c "import json,sys; p=sys.argv[1]; d=json.load(open(p)); d['elements']=d['elements'][:1]; json.dump(d, open(p,'w'))" @DIR@/sketch.excalidraw
wait:1.5
page-js:libertty_canvas.api.getSceneElements().length ==> 1
# Unsaved and changed on disk: the save is refused, never overwriting.
# (Its save held back meanwhile: a busy machine is slower than the 0.4 s.)
page-js:(() => { window.libertty_save_delay = 60000; return "held"; })() ==> held
page-js:(() => { const a = libertty_canvas.api; a.updateScene({ elements: [...a.getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted(), { ...a.getSceneElements()[0], id: "second", x: 600, version: 1 }] }); return "ok"; })()
shell:perl -MJSON::PP -0777 -i -pe '$d = decode_json($_); $d->{appState} = {viewBackgroundColor => "#123456"}; $_ = encode_json($d)' @DIR@/sketch.excalidraw
wait:1.5
expect-shell:grep -c second @DIR@/sketch.excalidraw || true ==> 0
expect-page:changed on disk
# Keep Mine writes it over the other change, as it said.
page-click:Keep Mine
wait:1.0
expect-shell:grep -c second @DIR@/sketch.excalidraw ==> 1
# Only the background changed: that's saved too (on its own, 0.4 s later, again).
page-js:(() => { delete window.libertty_save_delay; return "free"; })() ==> free
page-js:(() => { libertty_canvas.api.updateScene({ appState: { viewBackgroundColor: "#abcdef" } }); return "painted"; })() ==> painted
wait:1.0
expect-shell:grep -c abcdef @DIR@/sketch.excalidraw ==> 1
# A new canvas: a file of its own in the data folder, saved as drawn.
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:new canvas
wait:0.3
expect-palette:New Canvas
key:enter
wait:2.0
page-wait:go
expect-tab:Canvas
page-js:new Promise(r => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (window.libertty_canvas) { clearInterval(t); r("ready"); } }, 50); setTimeout(() => r("never"), 4000); }) ==> ready
page-js:(() => { const a = libertty_canvas.api; a.updateScene({ elements: [{ type: "ellipse", id: "probe-ellipse", x: 10, y: 10, width: 80, height: 50, angle: 0, strokeColor: "#1e1e1e", backgroundColor: "transparent", fillStyle: "solid", strokeWidth: 2, strokeStyle: "solid", roughness: 1, opacity: 100, groupIds: [], frameId: null, roundness: null, seed: 3, version: 1, versionNonce: 3, isDeleted: false, boundElements: null, updated: 1, link: null, locked: false, index: "a0" }] }); return "drawn"; })() ==> drawn
wait:1.5
